name: Goat, Wolf, & Cabbage
bio: Goat, Wolf, & Cabbage is the studio behind Secret Hitler, the hidden-role party game created by Mike Boxleiter, Tommy Maranges and Mac Schubert and funded by 34,565 Kickstarter backers. The full game is released under a Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, with the print-and-play sheets and the rules free to download from secrethitler.com; the boxed edition is sold through Blackbox.
